channel.title: Hippo updates
channel.description: Stable and opt-in beta updates for Hippo.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.0
item.description:
# Hippo 1.0.0
First public release with built-in updates.
- Check for updates from the Hippo menu or Settings → Updates. - Automatic update checks, with installation kept out of active recordings. - Optional beta updates for testing upcoming releases before Stable. - Sidebar icons and selection highlights follow your chosen accent, with readable selected text. - A wider, top-aligned meeting timeline with pinned speaker names and scrolling. - A more prominent “Check again” button in the live meeting’s People tab. - DeepSeek removed from meeting summary and fallback choices; Ollama remains available for local models. Existing DeepSeek summary selections move to Apple on-device.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized.
Existing users: install this release manually once to enable future in-app updates.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Improves Today’s Brief and meeting review workflows. Brief suggestions now have a separate persistent checklist; Action Items and Timeline views have clearer controls and accessibility descriptions; the Home and Known Voices views are easier to scan.
Requires macOS 26 or later. Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Action Items now adapts its controls to the available window width. Wider views use a compact header; narrower views keep the title and controls readable and provide all scopes in a menu.
Requires macOS 26 or later. Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixes Action Items checkboxes so clicking anywhere inside the square toggles completion, including the empty center of an unchecked box.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
## What's new
- Added an automatic write-up delay setting. Choose a delay from 1 to 1,440 minutes in Settings → When. - Delayed write-ups resume when Hippo next opens if the app is closed at the deadline. - Choosing “Only when I ask” cancels scheduled write-ups. Existing immediate behavior remains the default.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.2
item.description:
## What's new
- Collapse the sidebar into a compact icon rail while keeping every section within reach. - Open Meetings from the rail to search recent meetings or browse your full meeting history. - Your collapsed-sidebar preference is remembered when Hippo restarts. - Navigate the rail and meeting picker with the keyboard, including Command-F search and Escape to close.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.3
item.description:
## Fixed
- Sidebar labels no longer remain stuck after selecting a section. - Keyboard-focus labels dismiss automatically while keyboard navigation and normal hover tooltips remain available.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.4
item.description:
## What's new
- Hippo adopts the Liquid Glass design language: translucent cards, a glass live-meeting bar, glass tab pills and buttons, and a system window background. - Chat bubbles, text fields and the collapsed sidebar rail follow the new look. - Collapsed sidebar: hovering an icon shows its name and hides it when you move away. The heavy focus box around clicked icons is gone.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.5
item.description:
## What's new
- Action item checkboxes highlight under your pointer. Ticking one shows the check mark briefly before the item leaves the list (Action Items and Home). - Confirmation and notice pop-ups now use your chosen accent color instead of the system accent.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.6
item.description:
## What's new
- Fixes voices being matched to people who weren't on the call. On Teams and Zoom, Hippo now only recognizes people on the participant list, and double-checks each recognized voice against that meeting's own audio before keeping the name or learning from it. - If a voice can't be confirmed, it's left unnamed so you can name it, instead of guessing.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.7
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.7 (beta)
### Speaker naming - **Smarter suggestions.** Hippo ranks the likely person for each unnamed voice and pre-selects the closest match with a one-tap "Yes" button. - **"Likely" hints.** When someone introduces themselves or is addressed ("Dana here", "thanks, Priya"), Hippo suggests that name. Nothing is ever named without your click. - **Your own voice is left out** of the candidates for the other side of a call. - **Safer learning.** Fixed a bug where naming a voice that was matched to the wrong person could rename someone else's saved voice. - **Fewer skipped voices.** Voices that the end-of-call check rejected are now asked about instead of being silently dropped. - **Steadier naming list.** The "Who is this?" list keeps everyone seen on the call, and a background refresh no longer cancels your Refresh.
### Pop-out windows - Open any past meeting in its own window to read its write-up, notes and transcript while you're on another call. - Right-click a meeting and choose **Open in New Window**, or use the button in the meeting header. Pop-outs are read-only.
### Speaker re-check from the recording (off by default) - After a call, Hippo can re-analyze the full recording and propose speaker corrections for you to review, apply, or undo. - Turn it on in **Settings → Transcription → Second pass**. It needs **Keep meeting audio** on, downloads an extra model the first time, and can use noticeable CPU for a few minutes.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.8
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.8 (beta)
### Meetings sidebar - **Pop-out icon on every meeting.** Hover a meeting in the sidebar, or select it, and an "Open in New Window" icon appears at the right edge of the row. One click opens that meeting's write-up, notes and transcript in its own read-only window. - The row's title fades out under the icon, so it never overlaps the text, and the icon sits in the same place on every row.
### Release notes - Update notes now show headings and bullet points in the update window instead of a single block of text.
Includes everything in 1.0.7: smarter speaker naming, read-only pop-out windows, and the optional post-call speaker re-check.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.9
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.9 (beta)
### Voices are named automatically after a call - **Auto-naming.** When a call ends, Hippo matches voices it couldn't name live against your library and names the clear matches for you. In testing on past meetings, most of the speech that stayed unnamed sounded clearly like someone Hippo already knew. - **You stay in control.** An **Auto-named N voices from your library** banner appears above the transcript, with **Review**, **Undo** and **Keep**. Undo puts everything back, one voice at a time or all at once, and never touches lines you've edited. - **Weaker matches become suggestions.** Anything less certain shows up as a pre-selected "Yes" in the naming sheet. Nothing else is ever named without your click. - **Fragments are joined.** A person Hippo split into several voices is merged back into one. - **Turn it off** in **Settings → Transcription → Second pass → Name voices automatically after a call**, if you'd rather only get suggestions.
### Recognition is more reliable - A person who isn't on the participant list is no longer dropped when their voice clearly matches someone you know well. - Two saved voices for the same person no longer cancel each other out. - Confirming a name now teaches the voice from that meeting, and voices improve gradually instead of being overwritten by the latest call. - Hippo never mistakes a colleague who shares your first name for you.
### For the curious - Each meeting now saves a short **why it was or wasn't recognized** report next to it, to help tune recognition.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon. This is a beta: please check the first few auto-named calls and tell us if a name looks wrong.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.10
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.10 (beta)
- Today's Brief: Hippo now confirms Copilot is in front before pasting the prompt, so it no longer pastes into the wrong app. - If Hippo can't drive Copilot, it leaves the prompt on your clipboard and notifies you to press ⌘V in Copilot.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.11
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.11 (beta)
- Today's Brief: fixes runs that timed out with "Copilot started but hadn't published its window" — Hippo now makes Copilot expose its message box so the prompt can be pasted and sent. - If Copilot still can't be driven, Hippo leaves the prompt on your clipboard and notifies you to press ⌘V in Copilot.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.12
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.11 (beta)
- Today's Brief: fixes runs that timed out with "Copilot started but hadn't published its window" — Hippo now makes Copilot expose its message box so the prompt can be pasted and sent. - If Copilot still can't be driven, Hippo leaves the prompt on your clipboard and notifies you to press ⌘V in Copilot.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.13
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.13 (beta)
### Client and project review - New Clients & projects overview gathers recent summaries, decisions, open questions, and approved outstanding actions from grouped meetings, with links to the source meeting. - Extracted actions enter a review queue. Approve, edit, assign, dismiss, or restore suggestions before treating them as commitments. Unassigned suggestions are not assumed to be yours. - Reviewed wording, ownership, approval, completion, and dismissal persist across summary regeneration and backup/restore.
### Chat and export fixes - Individual-meeting chat uses the selected local chat model and checks availability before starting. - Export filenames include the meeting ID to avoid overwriting same-title meetings on the same day. - Action lists in exports use approved actions. Existing exports remain snapshots; re-export after changing reviews.
### Before updating - Keep a backup of your Hippo library. Existing completed and dismissed actions migrate; other extracted actions require review. - Meetings containing reviewed actions are protected from merging until review-preserving merge support is available. - An older Hippo version cannot read the new action-review ledger. Downgrading the app alone does not roll back library state.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.14
item.description: - Naming a voice after a call is faster: the name list now has a search box. Type to filter, press Return to pick the top match. - Searching for a speaker in the transcript now ignores accents, so "Jose" finds "José".

item.title: Hippo 1.0.15
item.description: - Known Voices now warns when two differently-named voices sound almost identical (usually one person saved twice) and offers a one-click merge. - Hippo keeps a second voice print for someone who sounds clearly different in some calls (another mic or room), instead of averaging both sounds into one blurry print. Applies when you name a voice yourself. - Naming a voice for someone you've met many times now moves their print, instead of being outweighed by their history. - Merging a split-off voice into a named speaker in a finished meeting now teaches Hippo that voice, so it's recognised next time. - "Merge duplicates" only merges prints that sound like the same voice; a person's second print is left alone.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.16
item.description: - Fixes a crash when focus mode turned on or off as a call started or ended. - Notes: type / for a menu (Action, Decision, Question, Timestamp, Screenshot, Checklist, Heading, Bullet list, Quote). Actions, decisions and questions get a timestamp while recording. - Notes: timestamps appear as chips; clicking one jumps the transcript to that moment.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.17
item.description: - Redesigned the "Who was speaking?" sheet after a call: one card per voice with the voice clip, a line it said, and up to three likely names as buttons. Other… opens a search to find anyone else or type a new name. - Named voices collapse to a single line, and the sheet has a visible Skip and Done.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.18
item.description: - Redesign continues: Home, Today's Brief, Action Items and Ask Hippo have larger, calmer type, glass cards, and one clear primary action per screen. - Ask Hippo: answers read as plain text with source chips, and the input is a floating bar that shows where the answer is computed. - Action Items: shorter header, a single Approve button per suggestion, and Edit or Dismiss in a menu. - Voices: avatar rows with one actions menu per voice (also on right-click). - Naming a speaker from the transcript now uses the same search list as the post-call sheet.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.19
item.description: - Settings now opens as its own window (⌘, or Settings in the menu bar panel), with a sidebar of sections. It is no longer inside the main window. - Sidebar reordered: Home, Brief, Actions, Ask Hippo, Clients, then Voices and Groups. Finished meetings get a toolbar with the title, section picker, rename, pop-out and share. - Transcript: the first words of a new speaker are no longer filed under the previous speaker when two people hand off without a pause. - Naming a speaker from the transcript now offers everyone on the call and every voice Hippo knows, like the Speakers pane. - Fixes a bug where notes typed just before switching meetings could be saved into the other meeting. - Merging a split voice into a speaker is safer: it only strengthens a voice that already exists and sounds like it, and counts once per meeting. - Return in the name search only picks an exact or single match; "/" then Return in notes starts a new line.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.20
item.description: - A new look: a soft accent-coloured backdrop behind the content, rounder cards, larger page titles, more spacing, and a quieter selection in the sidebar and lists. Links, tags and Settings now follow your accent colour instead of mixing colours. - Finished meetings: the toolbar now fits at the default window size (the section switch is icons), and Share looks like the other toolbar buttons. - Notes: the formatting controls float at the bottom as one glass bar, with a timestamp button and a Capture screen button while recording. - During a call, the transcript sits beside your notes when the window is wide enough. - Secondary text is larger (11 pt) across the app, including Settings. - Voices: Rename now applies to all of a person's voice prints.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.21
item.description: - Toolbar icons on finished meetings now show their names when you hover over them. - Settings is one click away: a Settings button at the bottom of the sidebar (and at the bottom of the collapsed sidebar), as well as ⌘, and the menu bar panel. - Settings sidebar icons now follow your accent colour instead of the system purple.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.22
item.description: - Meeting summaries: action items now record who took the work on, including hand-offs ("sure", "will do"), and only set a due date when one was stated. - Action item owners are never "Client", "TBD" or a team name; unnamed speakers keep their "Speaker N" label. - Quotes behind action items include the request and the acceptance together. - Toolbar icons on finished meetings show their names when you hover over them.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.23
item.description: - New Liquid Glass look: the pane switch and in-window pickers are glass controls with a lens that slides to your choice (you can drag across it), and buttons are glass capsules instead of filled rectangles. - Sidebar selection is a glass capsule in your accent colour, Settings is a floating glass pill, and write-up sections are glass cards. - Screenshots in notes can be deleted: click one to select it and press Delete, or use the × that appears on hover. Double-click opens it. - Focus window: the top bar no longer drops down the window when the Transcript or People tab is empty.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.24
item.description: - A redesigned look in light and dark: a coloured ground under the window with glass sidebar and toolbar over it, and the content on one inset panel. - The write-up has a new header (title, date, length, attendees), icon sections, a People and Timeline column in wide windows, and action items as a table with owners and Approve buttons. - Search moved to the toolbar; the sidebar now starts with the Hippo name and icon. - Every main screen opens with the same title block, and body text is slightly larger (13 pt). - The default accent colour is now blue (your saved choice is kept). - Pane switches use the system's glass segmented control, with a name on each icon for VoiceOver and hover.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.25
item.description: - Live call, main window: a floating card on the Notes tab shows who is speaking and their last line; the participants row is tidier. - Live call, focus window: a speaker strip under the tabs; the notes format bar now has a shorter version in narrow windows, so Capture screen no longer stretches it. - The Recording row in the sidebar is translucent glass with a red edge instead of an orange fill. - The menu bar panel's Pause, Stop, Shot and Notes buttons are capsules that stay on one line, with Stop in red. - A new Hippo header at the top of the sidebar.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.26
item.description: - The floating "who is speaking" card is gone from the main window's Notes tab. - Notes autosave is a small dot in the top corner of the notes (pulses while saving, says "Save failed" in orange only if a save fails), so it no longer overlaps the format bar. - In narrow windows the participant faces drop out of the live top bar instead of overlapping the Live/Review control.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.27
item.description: - Focus window: the notes format bar now floats inside the notes card instead of hanging below it with a gap. - New active-speaker strip: a glass capsule with the speaker's avatar ring, name, their latest words fading in, and a small level indicator; it stays the same height and says "Listening…" between speakers.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.28
item.description: - New live status bar at the bottom of live windows: a glass capsule with the active speaker's avatar and name, a smooth waveform line that swells with the voice, and speaker and microphone icons that light up while each side is carrying audio. It sits inset from the window edges.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.0
item.description:
Hippo 1.1.0 is a major update.
**A new look.** Liquid Glass throughout: a coloured ground under the window with a glass sidebar and toolbar, content on one calm inset panel, capsule controls, light and dark. Every screen opens with the same title block, and body text is a little larger.
**Better write-ups.** A new write-up page with an icon for each section, a People and Timeline column in wide windows, and action items as a table with owners, due dates and Approve buttons. Summaries now record who actually took each task on (including "sure, will do" hand-offs), only set due dates that were stated, and never use "Client" or "TBD" as an owner.
**Live calls.** A new live status bar with the active speaker and a waveform, a floating notes format bar with one-tap Capture screen, a compact speaker strip in the focus window, and notes autosave shown as a small dot.
**Voices that learn.** Searchable name lists when you name speakers, a warning for look-alike voices, second voiceprints for people who sound different on different setups, and merging two voices now teaches Hippo both.
**Notes.** Timestamp chips, a slash menu, screenshots you can select and delete, and a Settings window.
**Everywhere else.** Search moved to the toolbar, the sidebar leads with the Hippo name, the menu bar panel has capsule buttons, and the pane switch uses the system's glass control with a name on each icon.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.1
item.description: - The meeting timeline now shows one lane per named person. If the same voice was split into several clusters and you named them the same, they share a lane instead of appearing as several people. - The name search in the "Who is this?" popover and the post-call naming sheet is a clearer capsule field with a readable placeholder and an accent focus ring.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.2
item.description: - The focus window no longer keeps getting wider: its width is capped, the faces in the top bar drop out when the row is too tight, and a previously saved oversized focus size is ignored so it opens at the normal compact size.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.3
item.description:
Design pass across the app. Beta: live-call surfaces (Focus mode, the post-call naming sheet, warning bar) are new in this build, so please report anything odd mid-call.
- Meeting view now has four named panes (Write-up, Notes, Transcript, People) in the toolbar; Timeline is a toggle inside Transcript. Chat is under "Ask about this meeting". - Decisions, open questions and actions in the write-up show a timestamp that jumps to that moment in the transcript. - After a call: a "Meeting saved" status line, and "write-up ready" notifications wait until the call has ended. - Naming a voice works from the keyboard: Space plays the clip, 1–3 pick a suggestion, Return confirms, with a preview first. - Live warnings now come with one action (Stop and save, Open Sound / Microphone / Screen Recording settings), plus new low-disk-space warnings. - Live view shows who has spoken and who has been quiet. - The level meter stays flat when nothing is being said, and respects Reduce Motion. - VoiceOver: action checkboxes and icon buttons now say what they do; transcript rows have rename / fix-speaker / correct-line actions. - System sidebar selection and native alerts; consistent text sizes; fewer repeated titles and button styles. - Known Voices filter aligned; Timeline lane names show in full; Settings gets the app backdrop. - New app icon (layered macOS 26 icon).

item.title: Hippo 1.1.4
item.description:
Performance and bulk actions. Beta.
- Faster: switching panes in a finished meeting no longer stalls. Leaving Notes used to re-save and re-index even when nothing changed (about 0.4 s on a long meeting); the sidebar no longer rebuilds on every pane switch; scrolling long transcripts is lighter. - Action Items: select several rows (click, shift/⌘-click, Select all, ⌘A) and Approve, Dismiss or Restore them together. Dismissed items stay recoverable in the Dismissed tab; Delete dismisses the selection. - The name picker in "Who was speaking?" is easier to read: names already used in the meeting are no longer dimmed. - The sidebar's date groups refresh at midnight.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.5
item.description:
Readability, focus window, tooltips. Beta.
- Easier to read: the dim grey text (dates, durations, group headers, captions) is lifted to meet contrast on the app's glass backdrop in dark and light; the selected meeting row in the sidebar now shows its details legibly; links and labels on selected rows and on coloured buttons are readable. - Focus window: its width is held to the compact size even if macOS tries to grow it, leaving focus restores your previous window size, and the compact size is remembered correctly. - Hovering the notes toolbar buttons, and the icons in the focus window, now shows their names. - Bullets and quote rules in notes follow your accent colour. - The name picker in "Who was speaking?" is easier to read.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.6
item.description:
Focus mode cleanup. Beta.
- Focus mode: removed the speaker strip under the tabs. It repeated the speaker already shown in the bottom bar, its text changed too fast to read, and its long line could make the window's top area wider than the window. The notes and panes get the room back.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.7
item.description:
## Hippo 1.1.7 (beta)
- **New: Recap.** A daily review of each finished day: what happened, the decisions, your commitments, follow-ups and open questions, each linked back to its meeting. Every day is kept in a searchable history. Yesterday's recap appears on Home. - **Fixed:** the Expand button in the call window could crash Hippo on macOS 27.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.8
item.description:
## Hippo 1.1.8 (beta)
- **Experimental: Read live captions.** In Teams, when you have Live Captions open, Hippo can read who is speaking from them (Settings → Read live captions, off by default). It only records for now and changes no speaker names. Nothing is turned on in the call and nothing leaves your Mac. - Includes Recap and the Expand crash fix from 1.1.7.

item.title: Hippo 1.1.9
item.description:
## Hippo 1.1.9 (beta)
- **Recap is easier to scan.** A short headline, a one-line summary, then a "How the day went" card of short lines (Morning, Midday, Afternoon), each linking to its meetings. Recaps you've already written reformat themselves into bullets; "Write again" produces the new layout. - Includes the experimental live-captions reader from 1.1.8.
